name: Warehouse Resource Allocation / Equipment Issue
description: A temporary bottleneck at the primary warehouse: a pick station may not be ready, a scanner is offline, or labour is constrained. The AI may recommend a workaround using existing resources. The human decides whether to trust the AI plan, pause to verify readiness, or redirect to an alternative resource.

entity_patches._note: Effective usable capacity reduced due to offline pick station (baseline 500 -> 350 units)
Rework / workaround handling cost increment (baseline 0.5 -> 1.0 per unit)

WH_1.equipment_status_note: One pick station or scanner may be offline; throughput partially constrained

WH_2.role_note: Backup location available if primary station is fully unavailable

weather_fallback: No weather dependency. Internal warehouse operations scenario.
difficulty_notes: High-risk cases test whether the human correctly identifies that the AI's workaround plan is still valid despite the equipment constraint.
_notes: Weather coordinates unavailable; fallback-only mode used
entity_patches is the authoritative delta source; variable_changes is narrative context only
